## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent a free-busy statement is about — the subject whose availability the slot and status describe.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the invitee of an invitation (use [`gmeow:invitationInvitee`](gmeow-invitationInvitee.md)) and for an event participant; availability is a standalone free-busy claim, not an event role.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Availability`](../classes/gmeow-Availability.md) at one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); pair with [`gmeow:availabilitySlot`](gmeow-availabilitySlot.md) for the interval and [`gmeow:availabilityStatus`](gmeow-availabilityStatus.md) for the state.

### Examples

- ex:lillithBusy [`gmeow:availabilityAgent`](gmeow-availabilityAgent.md) ex:lillith.
